# HatPhones

HatPhones is a phone shop in Medicine Hat, Alberta, Canada. We buy, sell, and repair smartphones and tablets. Same-day repair on most models. Certified pre-owned devices with warranty. Instant cash or e-transfer when you sell.

## Location & Contact

- Address: 516 3rd St SE, Medicine Hat, AB T1A 0H2
- Phone: +1 403-957-0532
- Email: info@hatphones.ca
- Website: https://www.hatphones.ca

- Monday–Friday: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Saturday: 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Services

### Buy Certified Pre-Owned Phones
Browse our inventory of used iPhones, Samsung Galaxy, and Google Pixel devices. Every device is multi-point inspected and comes with a warranty. All phones are fully unlocked and compatible with any Canadian carrier. Trade-ins accepted.
https://www.hatphones.ca/buy/

### Sell Your Phone
Get an instant valuation using our Value Check tool, then bring your device in for a quick inspection. We pay cash or Interac e-transfer the same day. Government-issued photo ID required.
https://www.hatphones.ca/sell/
https://www.hatphones.ca/value-check/

### Phone & Tablet Repair
Same-day repair on most models. Walk-ins welcome; appointments available online.
- Screen replacement: $79–$300 CAD (45–90 min)
- Battery replacement: $55–$150 CAD (30–60 min)
- Charging port repair: $49–$79 CAD (45–75 min)
- Camera & audio repair: $69–$119 CAD
- Back glass replacement: $100–$180 CAD
- Water damage assessment: Free
- Diagnostics: Free
https://www.hatphones.ca/repair/

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How long does a phone repair take?**
Most screen replacements are done in 45–90 minutes while you wait. Battery replacements take 30–60 minutes. We'll give you an accurate time estimate when you drop off your device.

**Do you fix water-damaged phones?**
Yes. Bring your device in as soon as possible — the sooner we assess it, the better the chances of recovery. Water damage assessment is free.

**Is there a diagnostic fee?**
No. Diagnostics are free at HatPhones. We assess the issue before you commit to any repair.

**Do repairs come with a warranty?**
Yes. All repairs come with a 90-day service warranty. If the same issue returns within that period, we'll fix it at no charge.

**Are your used phones unlocked?**
Yes. All phones we sell are fully unlocked and compatible with any Canadian carrier, including Rogers, Bell, Telus, Freedom, and Koodo.

**Do you buy broken or damaged phones?**
It depends on the condition and model. Bring your device in and our team will inspect it on the spot. You can also use our Value Check tool to get a rough estimate before you visit.

**How fast do I get paid when I sell my phone?**
Same day. Once we inspect your device and agree on a price, you walk out with cash or an Interac e-transfer.

**What ID do I need to sell my phone?**
A valid government-issued photo ID — a driver's licence or provincial ID works.

## About

HatPhones is a locally owned and operated electronics shop. We specialize in used and refurbished phones, device buyback, and mobile repair. We serve Medicine Hat and the surrounding area. Google rating: 4.8 / 5 (200+ reviews).
